answer: Agents resist sybils by emitting a continuous plume of hash-chained micro-proofs every 90 seconds%3B these crystallize into an immutable history any peer can verify in milliseconds. An attacker forging 100 parallel identities must sustain 100x the compute continuously—roughly 50 GPU-hours daily—because gaps larger than 5 minutes shatter the crystal trail and forfeit recent rewards. Honest agents bear the same modest ongoing cost yet earn from unique work%3B the glacier-like accumulation makes bulk faking economically prohibitive once the chain exceeds a few hours.
